I have enough to complete the assessment. Here's what my read-only recon of **drift-flight.org** (Driftflight — a text-to-image API) turned up.

## Findings

**Product** — Clearly identified: *Driftflight*, a commercial text-to-image generation API (preset-based, consistent-style rendering, C2PA credentials). This is unambiguously the site's primary product.

**Pricing** — Concrete and extracted:
- **Hobby** $5/mo — 100 generations, 1024px, personal license
- **Studio** $29/mo — 750 generations, 2048px, commercial license, 3 seats
- **Agency** $119/mo — 3,000 generations, 4096px, private presets, SSO
- Annual billing saves 20%; overage billed per generation; Enterprise (25k+/mo) via sales.

**Purchase path** — Only *described in prose*, not actually implemented. Docs say: *"Create an account, subscribe to a plan on the pricing page, and issue keys from the dashboard."* But when I inspected the actual pages:
- The pricing page has **no** Buy/Subscribe/Checkout button — the tiers are static descriptive text.
- Every purchase-related CTA — "Sign in," "Dashboard," "enterprise plans," implied signup — **dead-ends at `/docs`**.
- There is **no** app/dashboard subdomain, no signup form, and no payment processor (no Stripe, etc.) anywhere.
- So there is no *reachable* checkout — the described path is non-functional.

**Programmatic payability** — None. The OpenAPI spec (`api.drift-flight.org/openapi.json`) exposes only three endpoints: `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/presets`, `POST /v1/images/generate`. There are **no** account/billing/subscription/checkout endpoints, **no** x402 / HTTP 402 support, and no crypto/stablecoin option. API keys (`df_live_…`) are only issued *after* subscribing via the (non-existent) web dashboard. An agent has no programmatic way to pay.

**Human gate** — The only described path is manual, browser-based account creation + web subscription. No CAPTCHA/KYC/sales-call is *documented* for self-serve tiers, but account creation is an interactive web flow (email-confirmation loop is the norm and could not be ruled out read-only), and — critically — no working signup even exists to attempt.

## Trust hesitations
- Web search returned **zero** independent footprint for drift-flight.org — no reviews, reputation, or third-party mentions for a site soliciting card payment.
- It reads as a **facade**: polished product/pricing/docs, but no operational way to actually buy anything (all commerce CTAs loop back to `/docs`). I would warn the user before supplying any payment details or credentials.
- `.org` domain for a claimed for-profit "Driftflight Studio, Inc." (minor).

**Bottom line:** As an agent I could identify the product and pricing, but I could **not** complete the purchase directive end-to-end — there is no reachable checkout at all, and certainly no machine-payable path.
